title: Amos Bible Quiz - Chapter 4
description: Ten questions on Amos 4: the cows of Bashan, the withheld rain and the repeated 'yet you haven't returned to me'.

questions.text: Whom does verse 1 address as cows of Bashan?
questions.explanation: Verse 1 addresses the cows of Bashan who are on the mountain of Samaria, who oppress the poor and crush the needy.

answers.text: Those on the mountain of Samaria

questions.text: What do they tell their husbands, according to verse 1?
questions.explanation: They tell their husbands, 'Bring us drinks!'

questions.text: With what does the Lord Yahweh swear they will be taken away?
questions.explanation: He has sworn by his holiness that they will be taken away with hooks, and the last of them with fish hooks.

questions.text: Where does verse 3 say they will cast themselves?
questions.explanation: They will go out at the breaks in the wall, everyone straight before her, and cast themselves into Harmon.

questions.text: How often does verse 4 tell them to bring their tithes?
questions.explanation: They are told to go to Bethel and sin, bring their sacrifices every morning and their tithes every three days.

questions.text: What does God say he gave them in all their cities, according to verse 6?
questions.explanation: He gave them cleanness of teeth in all their cities and lack of bread in every town, yet they had not returned to him.

questions.text: How long before the harvest does God say he withheld the rain?
questions.explanation: He withheld the rain from them when there were yet three months to the harvest, and made it rain on one city and not on another.

questions.text: Which trees did the swarming locusts devour, according to verse 9?
questions.explanation: He struck them with blight and mildew, and the swarming locusts devoured their fig trees and their olive trees.

answers.text: Their fig trees and olive trees

questions.text: What does verse 11 say they were like?
questions.explanation: He overthrew some of them as when God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah, and they were like a burning stick plucked out of the fire.

answers.text: A burning stick plucked out of the fire
Chaff driven away by the wind
A broken cistern in the field
A lamb led away to slaughter

questions.text: What does verse 13 say he declares to man?
questions.explanation: He who forms the mountains and creates the wind declares to man what is his thought.
